# Sparkline Design System for SwiftUI

> SwiftUI component library for iOS and iPadOS, distributed as a Swift package. Every component is themed through semantic color tokens that follow the system light/dark setting. These docs are written for AI coding agents building product screens from the library.

Before writing UI: add the `Sparkline` package, call `SPFonts.register()` once at launch, and use the Sparkline component for any control that has one. Bind values with `Binding`s, handle actions with closures, and disable with `.disabled(_:)`. Style app code with `Color.sp…`, `SPSpacing`, `SPRadius`, `.spShadow` and `.spTextStyle` only.

## Guides

- [Building an app with Sparkline](docs/agents/building-with-sparkline.md): setup, rules, and what to do when a component is missing. Read first.
- [Tokens](docs/agents/tokens.md): semantic color, spacing, radius, shadow and type tokens for app code.

## Components

- [Avatar](Sources/Sparkline/Components/Avatar/USAGE.md): `SPAvatar` is a small circular representation of a person: initials, a photo or a generic account icon. It can show a status dot or a notification count.
- [Badge](Sources/Sparkline/Components/Badge/USAGE.md): `SPBadge` is a small status marker: a numeric count or a colored dot.
- [Button](Sources/Sparkline/Components/Button/USAGE.md): `SPButton` triggers an action. Three emphasis levels: `.filled` (primary), `.outlined` (secondary), `.text` (tertiary or inline).
- [ButtonGroup](Sources/Sparkline/Components/ButtonGroup/USAGE.md): `SPButtonGroup` is a segmented control: a row of connected buttons where exactly one is selected. It binds to a value of any `Hashable` type.
- [Card](Sources/Sparkline/Components/Card/USAGE.md): `SPCard` is a container surface for grouping related content. It only draws the surface (background, border or shadow, radius, padding); you supply the content.
- [Checkbox](Sources/Sparkline/Components/Checkbox/USAGE.md): `SPCheckbox` is a labeled checkbox for on/off choices and consent. It supports an indeterminate (mixed) state.
- [Chip](Sources/Sparkline/Components/Chip/USAGE.md): `SPChip` is a compact pill for a tag, filter or selection. Passing `onRemove` makes it clearable: a remove button appears on the right.
- [Icon](Sources/Sparkline/Components/Icon/USAGE.md): `SPIcon` renders an icon from the Sparkline registry, drawn on a 24×24 grid. `SPIconShape` is the same icon as a `Shape`.
- [Input](Sources/Sparkline/Components/Input/USAGE.md): `SPInput` is a single-line text field with a label, helper or error text, and optional icons. It binds to a `String`.
- [Radio](Sources/Sparkline/Components/Radio/USAGE.md): `SPRadioGroup` is a set of radio buttons where exactly one is selected. `SPRadio` is a single radio, for when you lay radios out yourself.
- [Select](Sources/Sparkline/Components/Select/USAGE.md): `SPSelect` is a dropdown for choosing one option, or several. The trigger is styled by Sparkline; the option list is the system menu.
- [Slider](Sources/Sparkline/Components/Slider/USAGE.md): `SPSlider` is a range control for picking a number between a minimum and maximum.
- [Stepper](Sources/Sparkline/Components/Stepper/USAGE.md): `SPStepper` is a progress indicator for multi-step flows: numbered steps with labels, horizontal or vertical. Display only. (Not SwiftUI's `Stepper`, which is a +/- control.)
- [Switch](Sources/Sparkline/Components/Switch/USAGE.md): `SPSwitch` is an on/off toggle for settings that take effect immediately. It shows its label leading and the switch trailing, like a Settings row. `.toggleStyle(.sparkline)` applies the same look to any `Toggle`.
